QUOTE: "`NavigationHeader` ... is a `forwardRef<SearchRef, Props>`. It does not use the ref itself. When `hasSearch` is true, it renders `<NavigationSearch {...searchProps} hideHeader theme topStyle ref={ref} />`... When `hasSearch` is false, `NavigationSearch` is not mounted, so the ref stays `null`."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that NavigationHeader forwards its ref to NavigationSearch only when `hasSearch` is true, and that otherwise the ref stays null (attached to nothing).
